cross_source_findings.finding: Page 23 body width without mirrors is 1813 mm; October 2026 price list records 1812 mm.
Page 20 states Hybrid 155 battery voltage 280 V; July 2026 price list records 200 V.
Ten page-20 payload values match the 2026-07-03 price-list ranges; four mild hybrid-G 140 values differ (452/521 vs 451/540 kg).
cross_source_findings.decision: Do not duplicate ten identical values; retain four historical brochure ranges and all later ranges.

cross_source_findings.finding: The brochure uses Hybrid-G 150 4x4 naming while the October 2026 catalogue uses Tribrid 150 4x4.
cross_source_findings.decision: Keep dated naming and source relationships; do not rename by inference.

cross_source_findings.finding: Page 8 YouClip prose states five standard plus two optional points; page 22 matrix shows 4/5/5/5 by grade.
cross_source_findings.decision: Retain as an unresolved source-scope conflict.

cross_source_findings.finding: Page 19 states the roof rack is incompatible with the panoramic glass roof.
cross_source_findings.decision: Record the exact incompatibility in the accessory compatibility row.

cross_source_findings.finding: Page 14 marks five colours as two-tone available; Czarna Perła has no two-tone marker.
cross_source_findings.decision: Record exact printed markers; do not infer grade applicability or negative availability.

cross_source_findings.finding: Page 20 cargo table and page 21 matrix conflict on the Hybrid-G 150 4x4 repair-kit context.
cross_source_findings.decision: Keep the affected cargo values deferred.

master_reconciliation.colour_palette_scope: Six model-level palette items; no configuration mapping because page 14 does not state grade applicability and page 24 contains a general grade-availability caveat.
master_reconciliation.payload_scope: Four 2025 brochure ranges remain source-bound; ten other values exactly match the 2026-07-03 cennik and were not duplicated.
